text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As we head into the Satsuki Sho, Yaeno Muteki finds herself reflecting on her past.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Back when she was younger, she would react to her emotions with physical strength. It was a habit she just couldn't break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But the strict guidance of her grandfather and the close support of her grandmother brought her to where she is today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Carrying her gratitude for her grandparents close to her heart, Yaeno Muteki swears to win the Satsuki Sho to prove how much she's grown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And her friend Sakura Chiyono O will be running as well. The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown tour is about to begin!
